entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who runs each morning at the encampment and is oath brother to Jace; he stays to see Zendikar safe.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: The new Commander-General of the Zendikari army who runs with Gideon and addresses the departing volunteers.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who is recovering after channeling Zendikar's mana, and who joins the Gatewatch for good.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage planeswalker who answers Ugin's anger and decides to go to Innistrad to find Sorin Markov.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker who plants four seeds in the glyph and then leaves Zendikar with the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An ancient dragon planeswalker who descends angrily on Jace and the Gatewatch for killing the titans.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: An ally of Ugin whom Jace decides to seek out on Innistrad.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Ugin's missing ally, thought alive somewhere.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A dragon planeswalker who engineered the release of the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: The demon who escaped, an obligation for the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A merfolk planeswalker Nissa thinks of as a future guardian of Zendikar.

entities.name: Munda
entities.description: A kor Nissa trusts to help Zendikar recover.

entities.name: Seble
entities.description: An elf sentry Nissa thinks of.

entities.name: Mother Luti
entities.description: The monk who will teach Chandra's students on Regatha.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: A dead Eldrazi titan whose skull Chandra uses as a chair.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: A dead Eldrazi titan.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The third Eldrazi titan, which Ugin says has left Zendikar.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of four planeswalkers who swore to keep watch against threats to the Multiverse.

entities.name: Zendikari
entities.description: The people and army of Zendikar, now dwindling as volunteers leave.

entities.name: Sky Rock
entities.description: The encampment of floating islands around an enormous derelict hedron where the Zendikari gather.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The ruined city seen from Sky Rock.

entities.name: Halimar Basin
entities.description: The valley where the titans fell.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Jace plans to find Sorin Markov.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: The plane where Chandra was an abbot.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane saved from the titans and now healing.

entities.name: Glyph
entities.description: The glyph of leylines burned permanently into the valley floor, glowing green, where Nissa plants her seeds.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: A looming problem that only planeswalkers can handle.

entities.name: Jaddi tree
entities.description: One of the four seeds Nissa plants.

events.summary: Gideon wakes before dawn and runs unarmored around the Sky Rock encampment, reflecting on Jace, Nissa and Chandra as the Gatewatch.
events.quote: This was his ritual, if it could be called that after only three days

events.summary: Tazri, now Commander-General, runs with Gideon and tells him she is addressing departing volunteers.
events.quote: The burden of command. It was now hers—Commander-General Tazri.

events.summary: Gideon says he is hers to command until he must go elsewhere to face new threats.
events.quote: he had pledged to the Gatewatch to intervene where others couldn't.

events.summary: Chandra serves breakfast heated with her hands, and Nissa brings blankets for her to warm.
Gideon tells Chandra the Eldrazi sweep seems done, and Chandra insists she is part of the Gatewatch.
events.quote: I'm in this, Gideon. I'm part of the Gatewatch now.

events.summary: Jace reflects that the Gatewatch has no plan for the third titan, Sorin, Nahiri or other threats like the Chain Veil.
events.quote: these were threats that could only be handled by Planeswalkers.

events.summary: Ugin lands furiously among the Zendikari, demanding to know what Jace has done.
Jace explains the plan and Ugin reveals that Emrakul is gone from Zendikar and that he knew the titans could be killed.
events.quote: Emrakul is gone, and has been for some time.

events.summary: Ugin scolds the planeswalkers for killing two ancient beings, says he will study their remains, tells Jace to leave, and warns of Sorin and Bolas.
events.quote: have proven to be an extremely arrogant and unreliable partner.

events.summary: Ugin departs, and Jace and Gideon decide that Jace will go to Innistrad to find Sorin Markov.
events.quote: I'll go to Innistrad and find Sorin.

events.summary: Chandra talks Nissa into leaving Zendikar with the Gatewatch, saying Nissa can still protect it by standing with them.
events.quote: No one else can do it,

events.summary: Nissa visits the glyph at night and plants four seeds, including a Jaddi tree and a bloodbriar, at its center.
events.quote: One by one she planted them in the holes she had dug.

events.summary: Nissa promises Zendikar's soul she will see it again and moves toward the others, agreeing to show Jace what she knows of Sorin.

relations.quote: he had pledged to the Gatewatch to intervene where others couldn't.

relations.note: Chandra declares herself part of the Gatewatch.
relations.quote: I'm part of the Gatewatch now.

relations.note: Ugin tells Jace he is an arrogant and unreliable partner and tells him to leave.
relations.quote: If you still insist on helping me, you may best do so by leaving.

relations.note: Ugin and Bolas are rivals; Ugin warns Bolas will be unforgiving.
relations.quote: Sorin Markov and Nicol Bolas will be far less forgiving of your interference.
And now, the two of them were oath brothers.
